title: Fix Multi-Language Support - Claude Respects Detected Language
description: Ensure Claude generates responses ONLY in the detected user language (Ukrainian/English/Russian) without mixing. Verify language detection flows from Groq → LanguageState → System Prompt → Claude's response.

stories.title: Debug and verify language detection flow
stories.description: Trace language detection from Groq through TranscriptionGateProcessor to LanguageState. Add logging to verify detected language is correctly passed to system prompt.
acceptanceCriteria: TranscriptionGateProcessor logs detected language at least with: DETECTED language=uk/en/ru from transcript=...
LanguageState.set_language() is called with correct detected language
System prompt includes detected language name (e.g., 'The user is speaking Ukrainian')
Logs show language flowing through full pipeline: detection → state → prompt

stories.title: Make system prompt force Claude to respond ONLY in detected language
stories.description: Update system prompt to be explicit that Claude must respond ONLY in detected language without code-mixing. Test with Ukrainian, English, Russian.
acceptanceCriteria: System prompt explicitly says: 'Respond ONLY in {language}. Do NOT mix languages. Do NOT respond in English unless explicitly asked.'
Test: Speak Ukrainian → Claude responds 100% Ukrainian (verify in logs and audio)
Test: Speak English → Claude responds 100% English (verify in logs and audio)
No mixed English/Ukrainian responses in either case

stories.title: Verify TTS voice matches detected language
stories.description: Ensure TTS voice selection follows detected language: uk→OstapNeural, en→AriaNeural, ru→DmitryNeural.
acceptanceCriteria: TranscriptionGateProcessor logs TTS voice swap: [TTS VOICE SWAP] from=... to=... lang=uk/en/ru
Ukrainian responses use OstapNeural voice (can hear Cyrillic pronunciation)
English responses use AriaNeural voice (can hear English pronunciation)

stories.title: Test end-to-end multi-language conversation
stories.description: Full integration test: User speaks language → Groq detects → Claude responds in that language → TTS speaks in matching voice.
acceptanceCriteria: make test passes with 800+ tests green
Test with Ukrainian input → responses 100% Ukrainian
Test with English input → responses 100% English
No test regressions from z.ai or other features
Daemon logs show clean language detection for both languages

metadata.taskDescription: Fix multi-language support: Claude must respond in detected user language without mixing. Verify full pipeline from detection to response.
